  from step obtain C l r σ where lr: "(l,r) ∈ R" and NF: "∀ u ⊲ l ⋅ σ. u ∈ ?Q"
    and s: "?c s = C⟨l⋅σ⟩" and u: "u = C⟨r⋅σ⟩"
    and nfs: "NF_subst nfs (l,r) σ Q" by auto
  from lr F have l: "funas_term l ⊆ F" and r: "funas_term r ⊆ F"
    unfolding funas_trs_def funas_rule_def [abs_def]
    by force+
  note clr = clean_subst_apply_term[OF l] clean_subst_apply_term[OF r]
  from only_applicable_rules[OF NF, of r] wwf lr have vars: "vars_term r ⊆ vars_term l"
    unfolding wwf_qtrs_def by auto
  note NF_conv = NF_terms_args_conv
  let ?σ = "clean_subst σ"
  show ?thesis using aliens s unfolding u
  proof (induct C arbitrary: s)
    case (More f bef C aft s)
    let ?i = "length bef"
    let ?n = "Suc (?i + length aft)"
    let ?C = "More f bef C aft"
    from More(3) obtain ss where s: "s = Fun f ss" by (cases s, auto split: if_splits)
    note More = More[unfolded s]
    from More(3) have f: "(f,length ss) ∈ F" by (auto split: if_splits)
    from More(3) f have id: "map clean_term ss = bef @ C⟨l⋅σ⟩ # aft" by simp
    obtain sbef saft si where ss: "sbef = take ?i ss" "si = ss ! ?i" "saft = drop (Suc ?i) ss" by auto
    from arg_cong[OF id, of length] have len: "length ss = ?n" by auto
    then have i: "?i < length ss" by simp
    from id_take_nth_drop[OF i] have ss_split: "ss = sbef @ si # saft" unfolding ss .
    from i ss have lsbef: "length sbef = ?i" by auto
    from id[unfolded ss_split] lsbef have id: "bef = map ?c sbef" "?c si = C⟨l⋅σ⟩" "aft = map ?c saft" by auto
    from ss_split have mem: "si ∈ set ss" by auto
    from More(2) mem f have aliens: "set (aliens F si) ⊆ ?Q" by auto
    from More(1)[OF aliens id(2)]
    obtain t where C: "C⟨r⋅σ⟩ = ?c t" and step: "(si,t) ∈ ?QR" by auto
    let ?t = "Fun f (sbef @ t # saft)"
    show ?case
    proof (rule exI[of _ ?t], rule conjI)
      show "(More f bef C aft)⟨r ⋅ σ⟩ = ?c ?t" using id C f ss_split by simp
    next
      show "(s,?t) ∈ qrstep nfs Q R" using qrstep.ctxt[OF step, of "More f sbef □ saft"] unfolding s ss_split
        by simp
    qed
  next
    case Hole
    let ?u = "unclean_subst"
    let ?τ = "σ ∘⇩s ?u"
    from Hole have id: "?c s = l ⋅ σ" by simp
    then have "?c s ⋅ unclean_subst = l ⋅ ?τ" by simp
    from this[unfolded unclean_subst] have s: "s = l ⋅ ?τ" and s': "?c s ⋅ ?u = s ⋅ Var" using id by auto
    have step: "(s,r ⋅ ?τ) ∈ ?QR"
    proof (rule qrstepI[OF _ lr, of ?τ _ _ □])
      note NF_conv = NF_terms_args_conv[symmetric]
      from NF[unfolded id[symmetric] NF_conv] have NF: "⋀ u. u ∈ set (args (?c s)) ⟹ u ∈ ?Q" ..
      from Hole(1) have aliens: "set (aliens F s) ⊆ ?Q" by auto
      show "∀ v ⊲ l ⋅ ?τ. v ∈ ?Q" unfolding s[symmetric] NF_conv
      proof
        fix si
        assume si: "si ∈ set (args s)"
        then obtain f ss where s: "s = Fun f ss" by (cases s, auto)
        with si have si: "si ∈ set ss" by auto
        note aliens = aliens[unfolded s]
        show "si ∈ ?Q"
        proof (cases "(f,length ss) ∈ F")
          case False
          with aliens have NF: "Fun f ss ∈ ?Q" by auto
          show ?thesis
            by (rule NF_subterm[OF NF], insert si, auto)
        next
          case True
          from NF[unfolded s] True have NF: "⋀ s. s ∈ set ss ⟹ ?c s ∈ ?Q" by auto
          from NF[OF si] have NF: "?c si ∈ ?Q" .
          from aliens True si have aliens: "set (aliens F si) ⊆ ?Q" by auto
          show "si ∈ ?Q"
          proof (rule, rule ccontr, unfold not_not)
            fix u
            assume "(si,u) ∈ rstep (Id_on Q)"
            then obtain C τ q q'
              where q: "(q,q') ∈ Id_on Q" and si: "si = C⟨q⋅τ⟩" and "u = C⟨q' ⋅ τ⟩" by blast
            then have q: "q ∈ Q" by auto
            {
              fix x
              assume qx: "q = Var x"
              with q have y: "(Var x,Var x) ∈ Id_on Q" by auto
              have "(?c si, ?c si) ∈ rstep (Id_on Q)"
                by (rule rstepI[OF y, of _ □ "λ _. ?c si"], auto)
              with NF have False by auto
            }
            then obtain f qq where q_fun: "q = Fun f qq" by (cases q, auto)
            from si aliens NF
            show False
            proof (induct C arbitrary: si)
              case (More f bef C aft)
              let ?n = "Suc (length bef + length aft)"
              show ?case
              proof (cases "(f,?n) ∈ F")
                case True
                from More(2) have si: "si = Fun f (bef @ C⟨q⋅τ⟩ # aft)" by auto
                from NF_subterm[OF More(4)] True have NF: "?c (C⟨q ⋅ τ⟩) ∈ ?Q" unfolding si by auto
                from More(3) True have aliens: "set (aliens F (C⟨q ⋅ τ⟩)) ⊆ ?Q" unfolding si by auto
                from More(1)[OF refl aliens NF] show False .
              next
                case False
                with More(3) More(2) have "Fun f (bef @ C⟨q ⋅ τ⟩ # aft) ∈ ?Q" by auto
                with rstepI[of q q "Id_on Q" _ "More f bef C aft" τ, OF _ refl refl] q
                show False by auto
              qed
            next
              case Hole
              then have si: "si = q ⋅ τ" by simp
              from Hole(2) have aliens: "set (aliens F si) ⊆ ?Q" by simp
              from Hole(3) have NF: "?c si ∈ ?Q" by auto
              from si q_fun
              obtain ss where si_fun: "si = Fun f ss" by (cases si, auto)
              {
                fix x
                assume id: "?c si = Var x"
                then have f: "(f,length ss) ∉ F" and id': "?c si ⋅ ?u = ?u x" unfolding si_fun by auto
                from f aliens have si_aliens: "si ∈ ?Q" unfolding si_fun by auto
                with si q have False by force
              }
              then have csi_fun: "?c si = Fun f (map ?c ss)" unfolding si_fun by (force split: if_splits)
              then have f: "(f,length ss) ∈ F" unfolding si_fun by (force split: if_splits)
              from QF[unfolded QF_cond_def, rule_format, OF q _ f] have qF: "funas_term q ⊆ F" using si unfolding si_fun q_fun by auto
              from si have "?c si = ?c (q ⋅ τ)" by simp
              from this[unfolded clean_subst_apply_term[OF qF]] q NF show False by force
            qed
          qed
        qed
      qed
    next
      show "NF_subst nfs (l, r) ?τ Q" using ‹¬ nfs› by simp
    qed (insert s, auto)
    have rσ: "?c (r ⋅ ?τ) = r ⋅ σ" unfolding clr
    proof (rule term_subst_eq)
      fix x
      assume "x ∈ vars_term r"
      with vars have x: "x ∈ vars_term l" by auto
      from clean_term_match[OF id, rule_format, OF x] obtain s where x: "σ x = ?c s" by auto
      show "clean_subst ?τ x = σ x" unfolding clean_subst.simps o_def subst_compose_def
        unfolding x unclean_subst ..
    qed
    show ?case
      by (intro exI, rule conjI[OF _ step], insert rσ, auto)
  qed
qed
end

context cleaning_innermost
begin
lemma clean_qrstep_preserves_SN_on: assumes inn: "NF_terms Q ⊆ NF_trs R"
  and F: "funas_trs R ⊆ F"
  and QF: "QF_cond F Q"
  and wwf: "wwf_qtrs Q R" (* essentially, we need vars(r) ⊆ vars(l) *)
  and aliens: "set (aliens F s) ⊆ NF_terms Q"
  and SN: "SN_on (qrstep nfs Q R) {s}"
  and nfs: "¬ nfs"
  shows step: "SN_on (qrstep nfs Q R) {clean_term s}"
proof 
  let ?c = clean_term
  let ?Q = "NF_terms Q"
  let ?QR = "qrstep nfs Q R"
  fix f
  assume f0: "f 0 ∈ {?c s}" and steps: "∀i. (f i, f (Suc i)) ∈ ?QR"
  let ?P = "λ s. set (aliens F s) ⊆ ?Q ∧ (∃ i. ?c s = f i)"
  from f0 aliens have "?P s" by (intro conjI exI[of _ 0], auto)
  have "¬ SN_on ?QR {s}"
  proof (rule conditional_steps_imp_not_SN_on[of ?P, OF ‹?P s›])
    fix t
    assume "?P t" then obtain i where id: "?c t = f i" and  aliens: "set (aliens F t) ⊆ NF_terms Q" by auto
    from id steps have "(?c t, f (Suc i)) ∈ ?QR" by auto
    from clean_qrstep_reverse[OF inn F QF wwf aliens this nfs]
      obtain u where c: "?c u = f (Suc i)" and tu: "(t,u) ∈ ?QR" by auto
    from clean_qrstep[OF inn F wwf aliens tu] c tu
    show "∃u. (t, u) ∈ ?QR ∧ ?P u" by (intro exI[of _ u], auto)
  qed
  with SN show False by simp
qed
end

context cleaning_innermost
begin

lemma clean_min_ichain:
  assumes inn: "NF_terms Q ⊆ NF_trs (R ∪ Rw)"
  and QF: "QF_cond F Q"
  and FR: "funas_trs (R ∪ Rw) ⊆ F"
  and FP: "funas_trs (P ∪ Pw) ⊆ F"
  and wwf: "wwf_qtrs Q (R ∪ Rw)"
  and vars: "⋀ s t. (s,t) ∈ P ∪ Pw ⟹ vars_term t ⊆ vars_term s"
  and ichain: "min_ichain (nfs,m,P,Pw,Q,R,Rw) s t σ"
  shows "min_ichain_sig (nfs,m,P,Pw,Q,R,Rw) F s t (λ i. clean_subst (σ i))"
proof -
  let ?σ = "λ i. clean_subst (σ i)"
  from ichain
  have ichain: "ichain (nfs,m,P,Pw,Q,R,Rw) s t σ" and SN: "⋀ i. m ⟹ SN_on (qrstep nfs Q (R ∪ Rw)) {t i ⋅ σ i}"
    by (auto simp: minimal_cond_def)
  show ?thesis
    unfolding min_ichain_sig.simps min_ichain.simps minimal_cond_def
  proof (intro allI conjI impI, rule clean_ichain[OF inn FR FP wwf vars ichain])
    show "funas_ichain s t ?σ ⊆ F" using funas_term_clean_term
      unfolding funas_ichain_def clean_subst.simps o_def by blast
  next
    fix i
    assume m
    note ichain = ichain[unfolded ichain.simps]
    let ?Rw = "qrstep nfs Q (R ∪ Rw)"
    let ?Q = "NF_terms Q"
    from ichain have P: "(s i, t i) ∈ P ∪ Pw" by auto
    from ichain have NF: "s i ⋅ σ i ∈ ?Q" by auto
    from P FP  have F: "funas_term (s i) ⊆ F" "funas_term (t i) ⊆ F"
      unfolding funas_trs_def funas_rule_def [abs_def] by force+
    note subst = clean_subst_apply_term[OF F(1)] clean_subst_apply_term[OF F(2)]
    from NF_subterm[OF NF aliens_imp_supteq] have "set (aliens F (s i ⋅ σ i)) ⊆ ?Q" by auto
    then have aliens: "set (aliens F (t i ⋅ σ i)) ⊆ ?Q"
      unfolding aliens_subst[OF F(1)]
      unfolding aliens_subst[OF F(2)] using vars[OF P] by auto
    note switch = wwf_qtrs_imp_nfs_switch[OF wwf, of nfs False]
    from clean_qrstep_preserves_SN_on[OF inn FR QF wwf aliens SN[unfolded switch], unfolded subst, OF ‹m›]
    show "SN_on ?Rw {t i ⋅ ?σ i}" unfolding switch by auto
  qed
qed

lemma clean_min_ichain_below:
  assumes inn: "NF_terms Q ⊆ NF_trs (R ∪ Rw)"
  and QF: "QF_cond F Q"
  and FR: "funas_trs (R ∪ Rw) ⊆ F"
  and FP: "funas_args_trs (P ∪ Pw) ⊆ F"
  and wwf: "wwf_qtrs Q (R ∪ Rw)"
  and non_var: "⋀s t. (s,t) ∈ P ∪ Pw ⟹ is_Fun s ∧ is_Fun t ∧ ¬ defined (applicable_rules Q (R ∪ Rw)) (the (root t))"
  and vars: "⋀ s t. (s,t) ∈ P ∪ Pw ⟹ vars_term t ⊆ vars_term s"
  and ichain: "min_ichain (nfs,m,P,Pw,Q,R,Rw) s t σ"
  shows "min_ichain_sig (nfs,m,P,Pw,Q,R,Rw) F s t (λ i. clean_subst (σ i))"
proof -
  let ?σ = "λ i. clean_subst (σ i)"
  from ichain
  have ichain: "ichain (nfs,m,P,Pw,Q,R,Rw) s t σ" and SN: "⋀ i. m ⟹ SN_on (qrstep nfs Q (R ∪ Rw)) {t i ⋅ σ i}"
    by (auto simp: minimal_cond_def)
  show ?thesis
    unfolding min_ichain_sig.simps min_ichain.simps minimal_cond_def
  proof (intro allI conjI impI, rule clean_ichain_below[OF inn FR FP wwf non_var vars ichain])
    show "funas_ichain s t ?σ ⊆ F" using funas_term_clean_term
      unfolding funas_ichain_def clean_subst.simps o_def by blast
  next
    fix i
    assume m
    note ichain = ichain[unfolded ichain.simps]
    let ?Rw = "qrstep nfs Q (R ∪ Rw)"
    let ?Q = "NF_terms Q"
    from ichain have P: "(s i, t i) ∈ P ∪ Pw" by auto
    from ichain have NF: "s i ⋅ σ i ∈ ?Q" by auto
    from P FP non_var[OF P] have F: "funas_args_term (s i) ⊆ F" "is_Fun (s i)" "funas_args_term (t i) ⊆ F" "is_Fun (t i)"
      and ndef: "¬ defined (applicable_rules Q (R ∪ Rw)) (the (root (t i)))"
        "¬ defined (applicable_rules Q (R ∪ Rw)) (the (root (t i ⋅ clean_subst (σ i))))"
      unfolding funas_args_trs_def funas_args_rule_def [abs_def] by force+
    from F(4) obtain f ts where t: "t i = Fun f ts" by (cases "t i", auto)
    from NF_subterm[OF NF aliens_below_imp_supteq] have "set (aliens_below F (s i ⋅ σ i)) ⊆ ?Q" by auto
    then have aliens: "set (aliens_below F (t i ⋅ σ i)) ⊆ ?Q"
      unfolding aliens_below_subst[OF F(1-2)]
      unfolding aliens_below_subst[OF F(3-4)] using vars[OF P] by auto
    have ti: "t i ⋅ ?σ i = Fun f (map (λ t. t ⋅ ?σ i) ts)" unfolding t by simp
    show "SN_on ?Rw {t i ⋅ clean_subst (σ i)}" unfolding ti
    proof (rule SN_args_imp_SN[OF _ wwf_var_cond[OF wwf]])
      show "¬ defined (applicable_rules Q (R ∪ Rw)) (f,length (map (λ t. t ⋅ ?σ i) ts))"
        using ndef unfolding t by simp
    next
      fix tjs
      assume "tjs ∈ set (map (λ t. t ⋅ ?σ i) ts)"
      then obtain tj where tj: "tj ∈ set ts" and tjs: "tjs = tj ⋅ ?σ i" by auto
      from ctxt_closed_SN_on_subt [OF ctxt_closed_qrstep SN[OF ‹m›, of i, unfolded t], of "tj ⋅ σ i"]
      have SN: "SN_on ?Rw {tj ⋅ σ i}" using tj by auto
      from F(3) tj t have F: "funas_term tj ⊆ F" unfolding funas_args_term_def by auto
      from aliens tj t have aliens: "set (aliens F (tj ⋅ σ i)) ⊆ ?Q" by auto
      note subst = clean_subst_apply_term[OF F]
      note switch = wwf_qtrs_imp_nfs_switch[OF wwf, of nfs False]
      from clean_qrstep_preserves_SN_on[OF inn FR QF wwf aliens SN[unfolded switch]]
      show "SN_on ?Rw {tjs}" unfolding tjs subst switch by auto
    qed
  qed
qed

end

end
